R01_hit.note: promoted input: passed, matched, output, artifact_hash, document present

R02_miss.note: absent input: passed True, matched False, output None, artifact_hash None

R03_failed_suspended.note: a suspended member: passed False, match None, document None

R04_expected_hash_mismatch.note: a wrong expected_function_hash: passed False, match None

R05_no_promoted_set.note: registered operation with nothing promoted: passed, entries, match

R06_over_capacity.note: FUNCTION_MAX_ENTRIES patched below the real count: passed False, entries real, match None, no row enumeration

R07_biconditional.note: across every probed state: match is None iff passed is False, both directions

R08_invalid_partition.note: exact class and message for a rejected partition

R09_invalid_operation.note: exact class and message for a rejected operation

R10_invalid_expected_hash.note: exact class and message for a non-64-hex expected hash

R11_uncanonicalizable_input.note: exact class and message for an input canonicalize refuses

R12_precedence_partition_before_input.note: bad partition AND bad input: which one is reported

R13_precedence_operation_before_expected.note: bad operation AND bad expected hash: which one is reported

R14_unregistered_operation.note: valid arguments, operation absent from the partition: class and message

R15_oversize_input.note: input above DEFAULT_MAX_BYTES: class, message, and that no ledger read happened

R16_missing_ledger.note: deleted ledger: class, message, and the path still absent afterwards

R17_malformed_stored_revision.note: corrupt stored operation scalar: class and message

R18_revoked_member.note: a revoked member produces a failed verdict, never an exception

R19_ledger_bytes_stable.note: ledger sha256 AND full iterdump text identical across hit, miss, failed

R20_clock_never_read.note: a System whose _now raises answers all three states unchanged

R21_events_unchanged.note: events() byte-identical and the event sequence counter unmoved

R22_source_never_invoked.note: a source whose propose raises resolves a miss without calling it

R23_one_snapshot.note: exactly one Store.transaction call, write=False, in_transaction True throughout

R24_evaluate_call_counts.note: evaluate call count per state: failed 0, miss 1, hit 1

R25_document_outside_snapshot.note: the returned document evaluated after the snapshot equals evaluating inside it

R26_canonical_equivalent_input.note: a key-reordered equal input resolves to the same hit
